column1: # Transcripts the chapters quote from running code.
# Columns (tab-separated): <transcript under snippets/>
# and, for emit only:
# test: the `bynkc test .` output of the project, from its `Running tests...`
# line to the end. scripts/check-book-tests.sh regenerates and diffs it.
# http: `curl` requests against `bynk dev` serving the project, each followed by
# the status and body it answers with. A body may wrap onto indented
# continuation lines; the gate strips each one's indentation and joins them with
# nothing, so wrap only where the JSON has no space. Requests are separated by a
# blank line and must target localhost:8787. scripts/check-book-responses.sh
# serves the project, replays each request and compares.
# emit: a file `bynkc compile . --output out --target <target>` writes, or part
# of it. With only a path, the whole file, byte for byte. With <from>, every line
# containing it; with <to> as well, the first line containing <from> through the
# next line containing <to>. Matches are fixed strings; keep spaces off their
# ends, where an editor would strip them. Selected lines lose the indentation
# they share. scripts/check-book-emitted.sh compiles the project and diffs.
